answers.how: The plane spans about 74 pixels across. Its fitted image acceleration is about 153 pixels/s², giving a scale of 18/153 meters per pixel. Width ≈ 74 × 18/153.
The plane is about 47 pixels long. Using the acceleration-derived scale of 18/153 meters per pixel gives length ≈ 47 × 18/153.

A quadratic fit to the plane’s frame positions gives nearly zero initial speed and acceleration of about 153 pixels/s². At 1.5 s, its speed is about 230 pixels/s; converting with 18/153 meters per pixel gives approximately 27 m/s.
